title: This Eagle's Talons Are Longer Than a Grizzly Bear's Claws

scenes.text: This eagle's talons are longer than a grizzly's claws.
It's the harpy eagle of South America, and its back talons reach about five inches.
It hunts high in the rainforest canopy, going after sloths and monkeys.
Its prey can weigh up to about seventeen pounds.
Its grip is strong enough to crush bone almost instantly.
Bear claws on a bird. Now picture one overhead.

first_comment: Guinness lists the harpy eagle as having the longest talons of any living eagle. Bear claws or eagle talons, which scares you more?
